createOrReplace.label: EU/EEA, Swiss and Surinamese nationals (statutory fee)
createOrReplace.description: Dutch statutory tuition fee (wettelijk collegegeld) for EU/EEA, Swiss and Surinamese nationals.

fields.value: Dutch universities charge one institutional tuition fee for non-EU students; no other compulsory university fees. Residence permit costs are separate.
Statutory tuition fee 2026-2027 €2,694 (full-time) for EU/EEA, Swiss and Surinamese nationals — Staatscourant regulation (officielebekendmakingen.nl), also listed by Dutch universities.

living_cost_source_basis.description: No official program living-cost estimate captured this pass; not fabricated.

createOrReplace.living_cost_source_note: Nuffic/StudyInNL official estimate: €1,000–€1,500/month midpoint €1,250 × 12 = €15,000/year. SOURCE: studyinnl.org/finances/daily-student-expenses-and-cost-of-living-in-the-netherlands (verified 2026-10-27). Previous value €12,000 was bottom of range, corrected to midpoint.
createOrReplace.notes: €22,400/yr for non-EU/EEA students, TU/e BSc Computer Science and Engineering, 2027-28 new entrant rate. CORRECTION: stored 2026-27 fee (€18,600); corrected to 2027-28 new entrant figure per official TU/e fee page.
